user.title: SA Emergency
user.description:
SA Emergency uses your Home Assistant configured location as the reference point for distance and relevance calculations.

Configured location: {latitude}, {longitude}

error.location_not_configured: Configure Home Assistant latitude and longitude before setting up SA Emergency.

init.title: SA Emergency options
init.description: Configure how SA Emergency retrieves and classifies incidents.

data_description.local_radius_km: Incidents within this distance from your Home Assistant location are classified as local.
data_description.regional_radius_km: Incidents outside the local radius but within this distance are classified as regional.
data_description.scan_interval: How often SA Emergency checks enabled incident sources.
data_description.include_cfs: Retrieve current Country Fire Service incidents.
data_description.include_mfs: Retrieve current Metropolitan Fire Service incidents.

error.invalid_local_radius: Local radius must be greater than zero and within the supported range.
error.invalid_regional_radius: Regional radius must be greater than zero and within the supported range.
error.regional_not_greater_than_local: Regional radius must be greater than the local radius.
error.invalid_poll_interval: Polling interval must be between 60 and 900 seconds.
error.no_agencies_enabled: At least one incident source must remain enabled.
